stories.title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters; damage seen at $320mn
stories.summary: Thousands sheltered at Bangkok evacuation centres on Monday as residual weekend flooding persisted, with damage estimates at $320 million. Floods across Thailand have killed at least eight and affected over 580,000 homes.

stories.title: At least 62 killed in northern India flooding
stories.summary: At least 62 people have died in Uttar Pradesh after days of heavy rain triggered flooding, damaging more than 1,000 homes and prompting school closures. Over 75,000 were also evacuated in the eastern state of Odisha.

stories.title: At least 24 killed as landslides, floods hit Nepal
stories.summary: At least 24 people were killed and 14 remain missing after three days of heavy rain triggered landslides and floods across Nepal, weeks after deadly August flooding. The Kali Gandaki river caused the most extensive damage, destroying homes and cutting road links.

stories.title: LLNL AI vision system inspects 3D-printed parts mid-build
stories.summary: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory researchers built an AI-powered camera system that inspects 3D-printed parts layer by layer during fabrication, analyzing printing data up to 100,000 times faster than manual inspection to catch defects before parts leave the printer.

stories.title: Oracle expands HPE partnership to scale AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Oracle expanded its collaboration with HPE to deploy HPE Juniper networking across Oracle's AI data centers, helping OCI scale its AI superclusters with intelligent telemetry for faster bottleneck detection. HPE issued Oracle warrants as part of the deal.

stories.title: VAST launches DataEnclave for confidential AI on sensitive data
stories.summary: VAST Data launched DataEnclave, a confidential AI runtime built on NVIDIA Confidential Computing that lets enterprises run models against sensitive data while keeping data and model weights encrypted during processing. The launch includes partners Cohere, CrowdStrike, NVIDIA and Cisco.

stories.title: Delpit shoulder injury could give rookie McNeil-Warren bigger Browns role
stories.summary: Grant Delpit's shoulder injury could open the door for Browns rookie Emmanuel McNeil-Warren to take on his biggest defensive role yet, per Dawg Pound Daily's latest on the Week 3 win over the Panthers.

stories.title: Quincy Williams is quickly becoming a problem the Browns can't ignore
stories.summary: Browns linebacker Quincy Williams is quickly becoming an issue the team can't ignore two games into the season, according to Dawg Pound Daily analysis of his early impact.

stories.title: Red Bull: Verstappen's car issue can't be fully fixed until 2027
stories.summary: Red Bull admits Max Verstappen's mysterious car issue cannot be fully fixed until 2027, meaning the team expects to carry the problem through the rest of this season.

stories.title: Steiner predicts Verstappen will go winless in 2026
stories.summary: Guenther Steiner predicts Max Verstappen will go winless in the 2026 F1 season, a striking call given Red Bull's recent form.

stories.title: Sainz backs bold approach for Williams junior Will Green
stories.summary: Carlos Sainz backs the bold approach guiding Williams junior Will Green's racing future, signalling confidence in how the young driver is being developed.

stories.title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 revised power unit plan
stories.summary: F1 has approved shorter races for 2027 to accommodate a revised power unit plan, changing the race format for the sport's next rules cycle.
